sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate still fails to encode the core correspondence obligation: the known branch only requires independent presence of stressLifeCurveType, propellerBladeMaterialProperty, stressLifeCurveSelection, and an evidenceArtifact, without constraining the selected curve and evidence to correspond to the blade material properties. Add or locate a canonical correspondence/evidence structure and bind the selected curve, material property, and evidence artifact through it; do not use presence-only evidence. Preserve stressLifeCurveType as the applicability basis, retain the ship owner, and retain the unknown alternative requiring absence of stressLifeCurveType and selection of twoSlopeStressLifeCurve.
